row: Paws and Tails Reiki & Therapeutic Massage

Based in the Tampa Bay Area in Florida, we offer informational videos about animal meditation, animal Reiki, pet massage, and pet first aid.  Although you do have to live or travel to the Tampa Bay Area to have a hands on therapy session for your pet, we do offer online classes for pet owners starting January 2021.  We often feature other pet service providers as special quests, along with cute dog and cat helpers.  

We encourage our viewers to go to our website homepage to purchase a donation gift certificate for a service animal, disabled animal, or shelter animal.  The animal helped by your donation will be featured in a tube video and you will be given a shout out.   Our patreon membership starts in Jan 2021 with special features and classes for pet owners.
